title: KEDDEH / BRAINK / IL-LLM Session Conceptual and Implementation Record
preservation_boundary: Comprehensive reconstruction of substantive discussion available in active conversation context; not byte-for-byte platform transcript.
canonical_laws: Word identity is invariant; active meaning is contextually instantiated.
Missing term is not missing runtime; untranslated is not invalid.
Dependency failure is not global application failure.
Provider unavailable is not control-plane unavailable.
Component unavailable is not service unavailable.
Component loss removes only its supplied inputs.
Output derivation selects the first complete deterministic path in path_a, path_b, path_c order.
Partial paths are not blended unless an explicit composite path exists.
Only non-derivable outputs are deferred or bounded-stopped.
Every runtime finding returns bilaterally to source lineage.
